title: Royalty Split Validator
description: Validates on-chain royalty split configurations against ERC-2981 (single-receiver) and 0xSplits (multi-recipient) rules. Checks Ethereum address format, per-recipient share range, sum integrity, duplicate detection, and optional per-recipient cap. Returns a deterministic config fingerprint for audit trails. Not legal advice.
